briefing_bubbles.text: (The teller waves you over with a smile)
'Last stop! Just deposit your remaining money and you're done.'

'Your profile -- **wealth: average**, **personality: balanced**. **Last time your deposit rate was 2.25%**. You currently have **16,025 yuan remaining**, which will **all be deposited into the bank** -- no need to worry about how much to deposit. Last time the average rate was 2.25%, **The economy is fully overheated, prices are very high.**'
'You only need to make one decision: what deposit rate do you hope to get? Don't worry, **deposits always succeed, there is no quota limit**.'
